# Scientist
1. Your direct superior is the Research Director.
2. Scientists may only generate anomalies using the Anomaly Generator if express given permission by the Research Director to do so. A maximum of three anomalies can be generated at a time, provided they are being taken care of and contained.
3. Scientists must ensure that anomalies are logged on a proper form, with a copy given to the Research Director.
4. If a dangerous artifact node is being worked on, Scientists must alert the station, and the artifact be kept in a safe or contained environment.
5. Scientists must ensure that the remains of animals or other generated lifeforms must be taken to the kitchen when their use is complete.
6. Scientists are not to use the Research and Development console, unless given express permission by the Research Director.
